title: @ffmpeg/ffmpeg mount(WORKERFS) throws 'ErrnoError: FS error' unless the mountpoint directory already exists in MEMFS
trigger: Calling ffmpeg.mount(FFFSType.WORKERFS, {files:[f]}, '/work') on the vendored @ffmpeg/ffmpeg 0.12 bundle
principle: Emscripten FS.mount requires the mountpoint to be an existing directory — it does not create it. Always `await ffmpeg.createDir('/work')` before `ffmpeg.mount(...)`. The error surfaces as an opaque 'ErrnoError: FS error' from the worker with no mountpoint context, so stage-tag the steps (readPart/mount/exec/encode) or debugging is a blind hunt.

cases.context: condensed-audio transcode leg: recorded part.webm read from OPFS fine, but mount threw ErrnoError → record failed 'io-failed' after a full recording session. Only visible via real-Chrome e2e.

applyFor: @ffmpeg/ffmpeg 0.12 mount/unmount in offscreen or worker contexts
ffmpeg pipeline stages that hide ErrnoError context
